svg.aria-label: Marginal SBC on the same 512 validation observations
svg.title: Marginal SBC on the same 512 validation observations
svg.desc: Each band adjusts over six marginals within one endpoint, not across fits or checkpoints. Prior-like c predictions can pass this screen.
